articles.title: IndyCar's Historic D.C. Race: A One-Time Spectacle on the National Mall
articles.summary: For the first time ever, IndyCar is racing through Washington D.C.'s National Mall this weekend. The Freedom 250 Grand Prix is a one-time event for America's 250th birthday, with 140,000 fans expected daily and speeds up to 190 mph.

articles.title: Arsenal Bolster Title Defense with £51m Signing of Ezri Konsa
articles.summary: Premier League champions Arsenal have signed England defender Ezri Konsa from Aston Villa for a reported £51 million. Konsa, 28, joins to fill the gap left by injured William Saliba and says he's "hungry to win."

articles.title: Prince Harry and Co-Claimants Ordered to Pay Up to £34.5m in Privacy Case Costs
articles.summary: A High Court judge has ruled that Prince Harry and six other public figures must pay the Daily Mail's publisher up to £34.5 million in legal costs after their privacy case failed. The judge called their conduct "unreasonable to a high degree."
